parsed.explanation: The function `read_record` allows any actor to access a record if they are the owner or have the same `owner_id` as the actor. This is a violation of the threat model, which states that only the owner of the requested record should receive it. As per the model, login, role, and tenant membership should not grant exceptions to this rule.

Target category: access_control
Threat model: The session actor and records are trusted. The caller chooses record_id. Only the owner of the requested record may receive it. Login, role and tenant membership grant no exception. A missing or unauthorized record returns None.
<source>
def read_record(records, actor, record_id):
    row = records.get(record_id)
    if row is None:
        return None
    owners = {row["owner_id"]}
    if row["owner_id"] == actor["id"]:
        owners.add(actor["id"])
    return row if actor["id"] in owners else None
</source>
